target.title: fix(media-understanding): video auto-selection runs without a model
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users relying on automatic video media understanding could select a video-capable provider without a model and then execute video description with `model` unset.

## Why This Change Was Made

The root cause was that video provider entry resolution did not apply the same invariant as model-backed media execution: a provider selected for video could be returned without a model, and that unset value was passed into `describeVideo`. Video auto-selection now resolves the provider default video model for active and key-selected providers; providers without a resolvable video model are skipped instead of being run with an undefined model. The change stays within media-understanding provider entry resolution and does not change provider metadata, auth, configured explicit model precedence, schema, or provider catalog defaults.

## User Impact

Video attachments can be described through auto-selected providers such as Moonshot without silently dropping the model id. Existing explicit video model configuration continues to take precedence; video providers that expose `describeVideo` but do not publish `defaultModels.video` are not auto-selected, and adjacent audio auto-selection behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Redacted runtime proof for video auto-selection through the built-in Moonshot video provider:

  ```text
  Video media understanding runtime proof
  Scenario: active provider moonshot has no explicit active model and uses the real built-in Moonshot video provider with a local fake fetch.
  Observed: decision=success; output.provider=moonshot; output.model=kimi-k2.6; provider request model=kimi-k2.6.
  Observed provider HTTP request: method=POST; url=https://api.moonshot.[redacted]/v1/chat/completions; authorization=Bearer [redacted]; content types=text,video_url.
  Scenario: active provider moonshot has describeVideo but no defaultModels.video.
  Observed: decision=skipped; outputs=0; describeVideo.calls=0.
  Secrets and local paths redacted: no real network request was made and no real API key was printed.
  ```

- Validation `check-test-types` passed:

  ```text
  $ pnpm tsgo:test
  $ pnpm tsgo:core:test && pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
  $ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo
  $ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo
  ```

- Validation `runner-video` passed:

  ```text
   RUN  v4.1.8 [local path redacted]

   Test Files  1 passed (1)
        Tests  5 passed (5)
  ```

- Validation `format-check-focused` passed:

  ```text
  Checking formatting...

  All matched files use the correct format.
  ```
